name: Self-Control (Hilm)

definition_by_age.4: Staying calm instead of getting upset.
definition_by_age.6: Hilm means staying calm and gentle, even when something is frustrating.
definition_by_age.8: Hilm is measured self-control and gentleness, especially when provoked or upset.

learning_objective: Children can describe staying calm during a frustrating moment.
